section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction section presents theoretical frameworks and literature review regarding intuitive eating, sexual objectification theory, and online interpersonal sexual objectification (OISO) experiences. The authors propose a serial mediation model to investigate whether OISO experiences are negatively associated with intuitive eating through decreased broad conceptualization of beauty and body appreciation, with a focus on adolescent girls in non-Western samples. No empirical data or study results are presented in this section.
